title: Urban Auto: QGIS plugin for annual built-up area maps from Landsat
description:
QGIS Processing plugin that builds a built-up area map for every year of a period (e.g. 2000–2025) from a city name or polygon. Training labels are derived automatically from open products (GHSL, WSF, ESA WorldCover, JRC GSW, OpenStreetMap, Microsoft buildings); summer Landsat composites are classified with gradient boosting, the year of built-up appearance is detected, and accuracy with 95 % CI is estimated from labelled check points (Olofsson).

Модуль QGIS для построения годовых карт застройки и анализа роста городов по снимкам Landsat без ручных обучающих точек.
